measurement: RPG campaign replay and size audit (RQ-0.9), scratch database
database: omnix_rq_a (scratch; campaigns created by the test suites)
findings: No snapshot is written when a campaign is created (revision 0), and the first snapshot is at revision 20, so turns 1-19 of every campaign cannot be verified from a snapshot. RQ-1.1 writes a pinned snapshot at creation and at the upcast boundary.

A freshly created campaign is already 1.7 MB: runtime_state.bootstrap_snapshot and state.bootstrap_snapshot (358 KB each), runtime_state.compiled_genesis_snapshot and state.compiled_genesis_snapshot (195 KB each) and setup_payload (557 KB) are creation-time artifacts, stored twice. Moving them out of the document (RQ-1.1 extensions handling, RQ-6.4) takes a new campaign under 100 KB and is the main lever for F2's 1 MB budget.
NPC-related sections are small today (max 7 KB in this sample); the v6 npcs section's runtime cursors fit the budget.
